_doc: A Ø10 mm steel round bar, as a ready size of the round bar family (profile-round-bar holds the family and how to give any other size). It has no maker's sheet: every dimension is the nominal one stock is sold by, so measure the bar in hand, and its area, second moments, torsion constant and mass are worked out from its outline. The drawn outline leaves out nothing a round bar has.
name: profile-round-bar-steel-10
